ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/x-www-form-urlencoded --- { user_name: p('responsys.auth.user'), password: p('responsys.auth.password'), auth_type: p('responsys.auth.type') }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.authResponse.endPoint ++ p('responsys.notifications.basepath') ++ vars.campaign ++ "/" ++ (if (vars.channel == 'EMAIL') 'email' else 'sms')

%dw 2.0 output application/json var recipientID = payload[0].recipientId as String default "UNKNOWN" var recipientMessage = payload[0].errorMessage default "INTERNAL ERROR" --- "Recipient ID: " ++ recipientID ++ " cause: " ++ recipientMessage

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "201", message: "Notification Sent Successfully", result: payload }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if ( error.description contains "NO_RECIPIENT_FOUND" ) 404 else if ( error.description contains "INVALID_MOBILE_NUMBER_FORMAT" ) 400 else 500
